tha-ap350:2.1: migaluddo tadā → migaluddho pure (sya-all) | tadā āsiṁ → pure āsim (pts) | āsim → G. S1 tadā āsiṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap350:5.2: apothayi → aheṭhayī (bj); aheṭhayi (sya-all) | aheṭhayī → apothayi (bj: machasaṁ) | apothayi → aheṭhayi (cck: sī. syā.) | aheṭhayi → G. apoṭayi. (pts note)
tha-ap350:5.3: pothito → pātito (sya-all) | pātito → pothito (bj: machasaṁ) | pothito → pātito (cck: sī. syā.)
tha-ap350:6.4: devalokaṁ agañchahaṁ → devalokamagacchahaṁ (bj) | agañchahaṁ → agacchahaṁ (sya-all) | agacch → S1 agacchī 'haṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap350:8.3: devakaññāhi āmodiṁ kāmakāmahaṁ → devakaññābhi āmodi kāmakāmi haṁ (pts) | ākiṇṇo → S1 akiṇṇadevakaññābhi. (pts note)
tha-ap350:8.4: kāmakāmahaṁ → kāmakāmihaṁ (sya-all) | kāmakāmi → G. amoditām. (pts note) | haṁ → G. akās'; ahaṁ; S1 akām'; ahaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap350:10.4: tiṇamuṭṭhiyidaṁ → tiṇamuṭṭhissidaṁ (bj); tiṇamuṭṭhe idaṁ (pts) | tiṇamuṭṭhe → S1 -muṭṭhiss'; G. -muṭṭhiy'. (pts note)
